integrity: The primary full text was inspected for the root normalization, ADE orthogonal decomposition, Voronoi facet-vector statement, and local instability theorem. The proof reduces the quotient exactly to root-lattice covolume and then uses classical Cartan determinants plus an eight-residue multiplicative inequality. The bundled dynamic program is supplementary and is not used to infer the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem minimizes the isoperimetric quotient only over Voronoi cells of simply-laced root lattices of fixed rank. It does not claim global optimality among arbitrary lattices or parallelohedra, and several equality lattices are unstable when one leaves the discrete root-lattice locus.
title: Global isoperimetric minimizers among root-lattice Voronoi cells
